mapper.sql: a.id, a.project_id, a.name, a.asset_type, a.mime_type, a.language, a.file_size, a.checksum, a.storage_key, a.content, a.parse_status, a.index_status, a.chunk_count, a.progress, a.error_message, a.created_at, a.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_assets a JOIN projects p ON p.id=a.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' WHERE a.project_id=#{projectId} AND p.status<>'DELETED' ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC

SELECT FROM knowledge_assets a JOIN projects p ON p.id=a.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' WHERE a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.checksum=#{checksum} AND p.status<>'DELETED' LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM knowledge_assets a JOIN projects p ON p.id=a.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' WHERE a.project_id=#{projectId} AND POSITION(#{sourceUrl} IN COALESCE(a.content, '')) > 0 AND p.status<>'DELETED' ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM knowledge_assets a JOIN projects p ON p.id=a.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' WHERE a.id=#{id} AND a.project_id=#{projectId} AND p.status<>'DELETED'
mapper.update: DELETE FROM knowledge_assets WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id WHERE p.id=#{projectId} AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE')

UPDATE knowledge_assets SET parse_status='PENDING', index_status='PENDING', progress=0, error_message=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id WHERE p.id=#{projectId} AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE')
UPDATE knowledge_assets SET parse_status='PROCESSING', index_status='INDEXING', progress=10, chunk_count=0, error_message=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId}

UPDATE knowledge_assets SET parse_status='SUCCESS', index_status='SUCCESS', progress=100, chunk_count=(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM asset_chunks WHERE asset_id=#{id}), error_message=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId}
UPDATE knowledge_assets SET parse_status='FAILED', index_status='FAILED', error_message=#{message}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.chunk_index AS "index", c.content, c.page_number AS "pageNumber", c.section_title AS "sectionTitle" FROM asset_chunks c JOIN knowledge_assets a ON a.id=c.asset_id JOIN projects p ON p.id=a.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' WHERE c.asset_id=#{assetId} AND a.project_id=#{projectId} ORDER BY c.chunk_index
